gloss: young proprietress (of an inn or restaurant)

definitions.gloss: young proprietress; landlady-in-training (of a ryokan or traditional restaurant)
definitions.explanation: The younger woman who helps run a traditional inn or restaurant alongside the proprietress ({女将|おかみ}) and is expected to succeed her, usually her daughter or daughter-in-law.

examples.japanese: {若女将|わかおかみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出迎|でむか}えて→出迎える：04633_demukaeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The young proprietress came out to greet us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若女将|わかおかみ}になった。
examples.english: Her daughter became the young proprietress of the inn.

examples.japanese: {若女将|わかおかみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女将|おかみ}→女将：12210_okami⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦{義母|ぎぼ}→義母：06724_gibo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心得|こころえ}→心得：07465_kokoroe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: The young proprietress is learning the art of hospitality from her mother-in-law, the proprietress.

notes:
{若|わか}〜 "young, junior" marks the successor in a family business, as in ⟦{若旦那|わかだんな}→若旦那：32551_wakadanna⟧ (the young master) and {若社長|わかしゃちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若女将|わかおかみ}: the young proprietress of a ryokan
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若女将|わかおかみ}: the young proprietress of a long-established business

RELATED WORDS:
